title: Resh: head (200)
summary: Close-up study of the letter resh in khaki-gold: three styles of the modern letter, its name, sound R, value 200, ancient head pictograph and meaning "Head", with a row showing the pictograph turning into a reversed form and then into the Latin letters R and r.

letters.meaning: Head (head pictograph; becomes the Latin letters R and r)

pictures.description: Small ancient (paleo-Hebrew) pictograph of a human head in profile, drawn above a grey underline, shown between the number 200 and the word "Head".
Evolution of the letter resh: the ancient head pictograph on a grey line, an arrow to a mirrored (reversed) head form, then arrows to a large khaki capital R and lower-case r.

keywords: twentieth letter of the Hebrew alphabet
